note: What the control needs from the existing rulesets. Nothing else is asked, and nothing is applied by the PLAN. Applied only on the Owner's go, in the order of transition.md.

rulesets.name: integration
rulesets.keep: every other rule and every other context, unchanged
rulesets.precondition: the context is reported for every pull request into kaal/**, observed on real pull requests

rulesets.name: promotion
rulesets.keep: every other rule, the merge queue and every other context, unchanged
rulesets.precondition: the context is reported for a merge group, observed once on a scratch target

after_export: rulesets-after/<id>.json, exported with gh api repos/<repo>/rulesets/<id> after the change, kept beside this file as evidence
